card.name: "To" after liver values return
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after return, returned, returns or recovered, when liver enzymes or liver tests come back toward baseline or a lower grade.

modes.label: Returned to baseline
modes.description: "to" after a form of return when ALT, AST or liver tests go back to baseline.
modes.example: After return<< to>> baseline values, treatment at a lower dose

card.writes: It favors word starts such as pres- (pretreatment) and similar beginnings, while suppressing nom- and pel- starts, so it likely sets up the words that follow "to" (baseline, pretreatment).
card.plain: It fires on the word "to" in phrases like "liver enzymes returned to baseline."
